Card Q&A.q: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "You may place 1 card with [Royal Knight] in its traits and a play cost of 13 or less from your hand or trash under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Activate 1 of that card's [When Digivolving] effects as an effect of this Digimon." At what timing does that [When Digivolving] effect activate?

Card Q&A.a:
Since both the [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] having been played and this Digimon attacking with  happened during this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, the Digimon being played and the attack are treated as having happened at the same time for the purpose of triggering effects.The turn player can choose the order in which to activate the [On Play] effect and any potential [When Attacking] and such effects.

When does [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect activate?

Card Q&A.a:
No, it doesn't activate.The [On Play] effect from [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was triggered, but it cannot activate because the [Sistermon Blanc] is deleted before it is able to activate.
